WITH "r1"("c8", "c9", "c10") AS (
  SELECT "r6"."c1", "r6"."c2", "r6"."c3" FROM (SELECT "pg_catalog"."unnest"($1::"pg_catalog"."bytea"[]) AS "c1", "pg_catalog"."unnest"($2::"pg_catalog"."bytea"[]) AS "c2", "pg_catalog"."unnest"($3::"pg_catalog"."bytea"[]) AS "c3") AS "r6"
),
"r2"("c4", "c5", "c6") AS (
  INSERT INTO "slice_den"."retry_skipped" AS "r7" ("root", "scope", "by")
  SELECT "r8"."c11", "r8"."c12", "r8"."c13" FROM (SELECT "r9"."c8", "r9"."c9", "r9"."c10" FROM "r1" AS "r9" ORDER BY "r9"."c8", "r9"."c9") AS "r8"("c11", "c12", "c13")
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING "r7"."root" AS "c4", "r7"."scope" AS "c5", "r7"."by" AS "c6"
),
"r3"("c8", "c9", "c10") AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT "r10"."c8", "r10"."c9", "r10"."c10" FROM (SELECT "r10"."c8", "r10"."c9", "r10"."c10" FROM (SELECT "r9"."c8", "r9"."c9", "r9"."c10", "r9"."c14", "pg_catalog"."bool_or"("r9"."c14") OVER (PARTITION BY "r9"."c8", "r9"."c9") AS "c15" FROM (SELECT "r7"."c8", "r7"."c9", "r7"."c10", false FROM "r1" AS "r7" UNION ALL SELECT "r8"."c4", "r8"."c5", "r8"."c6", true FROM "r2" AS "r8") AS "r9"("c8", "c9", "c10", "c14")) AS "r10" WHERE NOT "r10"."c15") AS "r10"("c8", "c9", "c10")
),
"r4"("c4", "c5", "c6", "c7") AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT "r11"."c8", "r11"."c9", "r11"."c10", CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LATERAL (SELECT "r13"."root", "r13"."scope", "r13"."by" FROM "slice_den"."retry_skipped" AS "r13" WHERE "r13"."root" = "r11"."c8" AND "r13"."scope" = "r11"."c9" LIMIT 1) AS "r12"("c18", "c19", "c20") WHERE "r12"."c20" = "r11"."c10") THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LATERAL (SELECT "r15"."root", "r15"."scope" FROM "slice_den"."retry_skipped" AS "r15" WHERE "r15"."root" = "r11"."c8" AND "r15"."scope" = "r11"."c9" LIMIT 1) AS "r14"("c16", "c17")) THEN 2 ELSE (-1)::integer END FROM "r3" AS "r11"
),
"r5"("c4", "c5", "c6", "c7") AS MATERIALIZED (
